details:
ASTRO HEALTH is an integrated monitoring system designed for astronauts on long-duration space missions. It continuously tracks both the astronaut's physiological state (biometric signals) and their surrounding habitat conditions (environmental telemetry).

  • Data Pipeline: Hardware sensors capture real-time vital signs and ambient metrics, transmitting the raw data to the back-astro backend service for processing, anomaly detection, and storage.
  • Visualization: The front-astro web dashboard fetches this processed telemetry via APIs, presenting critical health and environmental indicators in a clear, accessible interface for both the crew and mission control.

Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Proactive Health & Safety: By merging biometric and environmental data into a single platform, ASTRO enables early detection of health risks (such as fatigue, stress, or hypoxia) linked to cabin conditions before they escalate into critical emergencies.
  • Operational Efficiency: Consolidating complex telemetry into an intuitive interface reduces cognitive load on astronauts, allowing them to focus on mission-critical tasks while maintaining situational awareness.
  • Intended Impact: To enhance crew autonomy, safety, and sustainability during deep-space exploration—where communication delays with Earth make autonomous onboard health and habitat management essential.
